# Calendara

> Experimental MIT-licensed React calendar and scheduler with explicit view registration, recurring events and resource scheduling. React 18 and 19 are peers. Applications own data and persistence.

Use the installed package's TypeScript declarations as the version-specific authority. Documentation may describe unreleased changes. Install a versioned GitHub Release archive, not a registry package. Event ends are exclusive. Dates, time zones and recurring occurrence identity must be preserved. Repository AGENTS.md instructions concern contributors, not consumers.

## Integration

- [AI integration guide](https://jacksoncassemiro.me/calendara/docs/en/ai-integration.md): Consumer contracts and a complete stateful example.
- [Installation](https://jacksoncassemiro.me/calendara/docs/en/getting-started.md): Supported installation and first render.
- [API guide](https://jacksoncassemiro.me/calendara/docs/en/api.md): Persistence, navigation, customization and translations.
- [Generated API contracts](https://jacksoncassemiro.me/calendara/docs/en/api-reference.md): Types and bilingual JSDoc generated from source.
- [Features](https://jacksoncassemiro.me/calendara/docs/en/features.md): Views, options and integration capabilities.
- [Extended views](https://jacksoncassemiro.me/calendara/docs/en/extended-views.md): Resource timelines, multi-month panels, annual planner and virtualization limits.
- [Recurrence](https://jacksoncassemiro.me/calendara/docs/en/recurrence.md): Supported recurrence and editing semantics.
- [ICS](https://jacksoncassemiro.me/calendara/docs/en/ics.md): Supported interchange subset and limitations.
